name: partly_hedged_invoice_inverse_quote_effective_rate
question_template: A US importer must settle an invoice of {INVOICE} FC (a foreign currency). All quotes are inverse: FC per USD. The importer hedged {HEDGE_PCT}% of the invoice with a forward at {FWD_RATE} FC per USD; the forward carries a flat USD {FWD_FEE} contract fee. The unhedged remainder is bought at the settlement spot of {SPOT_RATE} FC per USD, and the bank charges {SPOT_FEE_BP} basis points of the USD spent on that spot purchase. Domestic clearance costs then change the bill by {DOM_PCT}% of the total USD paid to the bank (both legs including both fees); a negative value is a rebate. Find the effective all-in rate in FC per USD, defined as invoice FC divided by total USD cost after the domestic adjustment.

slots.description: USD paid for the forward leg including the flat contract fee.
USD paid for the spot leg including the basis-point fee.
Total USD cost after the signed domestic clearance adjustment.

program:
def solve():
    inv = Q(P["INVOICE"])
    h = Q(P["HEDGE_PCT"]) / 100
    fwd = Q(P["FWD_RATE"])
    spot = Q(P["SPOT_RATE"])
    fwd_fee = Q(P["FWD_FEE"])
    bp = Q(P["SPOT_FEE_BP"]) / 10000
    dom = Q(P["DOM_PCT"]) / 100
    hedged_fc = inv * h
    spot_fc = inv - hedged_fc
    hedged_usd = hedged_fc / fwd + fwd_fee
    spot_usd = (spot_fc / spot) * (1 + bp)
    bank_total = hedged_usd + spot_usd
    total = bank_total * (1 + dom)
    if total <= 0:
        raise ValueError("total USD cost must be positive")
    eff = inv / total
    return {
        "final": eff,
        "hedged_leg_usd": hedged_usd,
        "spot_leg_usd": spot_usd,
        "total_usd_cost": total,
    }
